nodes.description: Owner address of the contract; assigned from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending new owner address; set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership via onlyNewOwner.
Public token name string, set to AAACoin in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set to AAAC in the constructor.
Token decimals (18); used as exponent when minting the initial supply.
Internal constant-like initial supply (1000000000) used to compute totalSupply_.
Internal total supply accounting variable; reduced by burn and read by totalSupply().
Internal mapping of holder balances; read and mutated by transfer, _transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and burn.
Internal nested mapping of allowances used by approve, allowance, _transfer and transferFrom.
Public mapping of frozen accounts used by the notFrozen modifier, freezeAccount and unfreezeAccount.
Ownable constructor: owner = msg.sender and newOwner = address(0).
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
onlyNewOwner function that promotes newOwner to owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Library multiplication with overflow check (not used by the constructor's raw multiplication).
Library division guarded by require(_b > 0).
Library subtraction guarded by require(_b <= _a); used for all balance and supply decrements.
Library addition guarded by require(c >= _a); used for all balance increments.
Library modulo guarded by require(b != 0).
Token constructor: sets metadata, computes totalSupply_ = initialSupply * 10 ** uint(decimals) with unchecked arithmetic and credits balances[owner].
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
View function returning the internal totalSupply_.
Internal transfer helper that moves balances and decrements the caller allowance.
Public transfer guarded by notFrozen(msg.sender); moves value from msg.sender to _to.
View function returning balances[_holder].
Public allowance-based transfer guarded by notFrozen(_from); delegates to _transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
View function returning allowed[_holder][_spender].
onlyOwner function that sets frozen[_holder] = true and emits Freeze.
onlyOwner function that sets frozen[_holder] = false and emits Unfreeze.
onlyOwner function that burns msg.sender balance and reduces totalSupply_.
Internal view function that uses inline assembly extcodesize to test whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address; drives ownership assignment, allowance keys, freeze checks and burn accounting.
Unchecked multiplication/exponentiation initialSupply * 10 ** uint(decimals) executed with raw Solidity arithmetic instead of SafeMath.mul.
Inline Yul assembly block reading extcodesize(addr); bypasses Solidity type/semantic checks.
Balance sub/add and allowance sub performed inside _transfer, protected only by SafeMath library calls.
Burn path arithmetic: balances[burner].sub(_value) and totalSupply_.sub(_value), protected only by SafeMath.
Transfer path arithmetic on balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to], protected only by SafeMath.

edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor, so the deployer controls privileged state.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyNewOwner modifier requires msg.sender == newOwner before acceptOwnership executes.
_transfer reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] to authorize the spender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and uses msg.sender as the sender.
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] for the authorization check.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval with msg.sender.
freezeAccount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
unfreezeAccount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
burn is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
burn debits balances[msg.sender], letting the owner destroy only its own balance.
Local burner is assigned from msg.sender inside burn.
owner state variable is written in the Ownable constructor.
owner is read by onlyOwner during transferOwnership.
owner is emitted in OwnershipTransferred and used as the previous owner value.
owner is compared against msg.sender by onlyOwner for freezeAccount.
owner is compared against msg.sender by onlyOwner for unfreezeAccount.
owner is compared against msg.sender by onlyOwner for burn.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
onlyNewOwner requires msg.sender == newOwner before acceptOwnership runs.
name is assigned in the AAACoin constructor.
symbol is assigned in the AAACoin constructor.
decimals is used as the exponent in 10 ** uint(decimals) during supply computation.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**decimals with unchecked raw arithmetic.
totalSupply_ is written in the constructor.
balances[owner] is credited with the entire totalSupply_ in the constructor.
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
_transfer reads and rewrites balances for _from and _to using SafeMath.
transfer reads and rewrites balances for msg.sender and _to using SafeMath.
balanceOf returns balances[_holder].
transferFrom checks balances[_from] before moving funds.
burn decrements balances[burner] via SafeMath.sub.
burn decrements totalSupply_ via SafeMath.sub.
_transfer decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender] before delegating to _transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without zeroing the previous value.
allowance returns allowed[_holder][_spender].
notFrozen(msg.sender) modifier reverts when frozen[msg.sender] is true.
notFrozen(_from) modifier reverts when frozen[_from] is true.
freezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = true.
unfreezeAccount sets frozen[_holder] = false.
transferFrom performs an internal call to _transfer after its checks pass.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for balances[_from] and the allowance decrement.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for balances[_to].
transfer uses SafeMath.sub on balances[msg.sender].
transfer uses SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
burn uses SafeMath.sub for both balances[burner] and totalSupply_.
Constructor supply minting performs raw multiplication/exponentiation without SafeMath.mul, relying on the 2**256 range instead.
isContract uses an inline assembly extcodesize read, which can be bypassed by contracts under construction.
_transfer concentrates all balance/allowance arithmetic, guarded only by library require checks.
transfer concentrates balance arithmetic guarded only by library require checks.
burn concentrates supply and balance arithmetic guarded only by library require checks.
_newOwner is validated and stored into newOwner.
_from parameter indexes balances and allowed inside _transfer.
_to parameter indexes balances inside _transfer.
_value parameter is the amount moved inside _transfer.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transfer.
_value parameter is validated against balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
_holder parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
_from parameter is checked against frozen and balances in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter is validated against balances and allowance in transferFrom.
_spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in approve.
_value parameter is written into the allowed mapping in approve.
_holder parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender parameter keys the allowed mapping in allowance.
_holder parameter is written into the frozen mapping by freezeAccount.
_holder parameter is written into the frozen mapping by unfreezeAccount.
_value parameter is burned from balances[msg.sender] and totalSupply_.
addr parameter is passed to extcodesize inside isContract.
Local burner aliases msg.sender and keys the balances decrement in burn.
Local size receives the extcodesize result and determines the isContract return value.
